verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI features run through a built-in MCP server. An external AI client of the user's choice can then drive Sketch, recreating components and even entire pages, rearranging layers, swapping light-mode components for dark ones, and filling in realistic text. There is no native prompt-to-design generator, and the documented page-creation path works from a code repo rather than from a free-form prompt. Missing for 10: native in-app natural-language prompting, documented prompt-to-first-draft or full-mockup generation, hands-on or independent corroboration of output quality.

support.subject: As a designer, I can generate or edit designs from a natural-language prompt — first drafts, layouts, or full mockups the tool actually produces

citations.quote: Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Point your AI client at a repo to recreate text styles, colors, UI components, and even entire pages inside Sketch.
Sort, rename, and align layers automatically.
Switch light mode components for their dark mode counterparts — all without making a single manual swap.
